text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali confers with (ruling party) Constitutional Democratic Rally (RCD) Secretary-General Abdelaziz Ben Dhia. RCD's Central Council to meet by end of October. RCD's parliamentarians to meet on October 21.
-Egyptian Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Ridha held talks on Wednesday in Tunis with Tunisian officials on bilateral cooperation.
- President recommends developing training within army.
